Silence Suzuka caused quite a stir by 
pulling off an ultra-front-running 
breakaway in her debut race.

Air Groove offered her words of 
appreciation, while advising the Trainer 
not to let that talent go to waste.

Taking those words deeply to heart, the 
Trainer reaffirmed their determination to 
be a pillar of support for Silence Suzuka.
